Exact-head source closure identifies the causal deadline composition introduced after the last known packaged GREEN: BackendProcessHost awaits asynchronous Windows owner process identity before writing the child startup frame, while backend/bootstrap/desktopStartupPipe.js independently starts a fixed 10-second readStartupFrame deadline immediately in the child. The child can therefore fail with BOOT_DESKTOP_STARTUP_TIMEOUT while the parent remains inside the authoritative lifecycle budget. Electron startup failure then enters the existing modal dialog path on the headless runner, explaining why the packaged process remains alive while no receipt is produced. PR #615's authorized eight paths do not include these root files, so #615 is frozen and this independent prerequisite is required before ordinary forward reconciliation.
